verdict.rationale: Docs show a broader AI assistant that can 'analyze performance' and 'build automations' (docs-1) plus AI in Slack (docs-20) and AI-generated design elements (docs-15/16), suggesting some data-informed suggestions, but there's no dedicated analytics/insights feature that surfaces AI-generated observations or recommendations from customer data specifically. Missing for 10: a documented insights/analytics dashboard powered by AI, concrete examples of data-driven suggestions (e.g. segment or campaign optimization tips), and independent confirmation of this capability in practice.
